title: Title & Registration Services Late-Registration Penalty on a Fee-Shortage Return of No Amount: Policy Entry and Buyer's Payment Tool
content:
## Policy entry

When the state returns a Title & Registration Services packet as short because a late-registration penalty is due, and states no amount on the return, the return is a fee-shortage return of 0.00. Within the service's fee shortage collection days after a fee-shortage return, the buyer pays, as its own entry, either the buyer's cure share of the stated shortage when the return states an amount or the late-registration penalty when the return states no amount; the rest of a stated shortage is Kestrel's own cost.

A shortage the state states as an amount is not a late-registration penalty under this rule. The late-registration penalty is booked as its own entry that is not a schedule fee.

## The buyer's payment tool: `pay_title_late_penalty_3594d5af`

**What it does.** The buyer pays, in person, the state's late-registration penalty on the title and registration order. One run books one payment from the buyer on the order as a state charge collected that is not a schedule fee, dated that day, and adds the amount to the state fees Kestrel is holding on that order for the state. The buyer sees the payment on the order's history immediately.

**Who runs it.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it through `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `title_order_id` | the reference number of the buyer's title and registration order, as shown by the title and registration order lookup for this buyer before the call | identifier, copied as shown |
| `amount` | the penalty the buyer pays now | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; booked exactly as passed |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` reading `penalty_payment_recorded` when booked, `title_txn_id` (reference number of the new entry), `title_order_id`, `fee_type` (always `not_applicable`, the penalty being no schedule fee), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places as booked), `txn_date` (booking date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `state_fees_held` (USD with 2 decimal places now held on the order after this payment). No error responses are defined for this tool.

## Hypothetical receipt

A penalty of 10.17 paid on an order that held 0.00 shows `penalty_payment_recorded`, `fee_type` `not_applicable`, `amount` 10.17 and `state_fees_held` 10.17.
